Priya: Quick status check — Dedicated EU capacity buildout. Where are we on procurement, rack readiness, and staging reservations? Any blockers?
Alex: Procurement update: vendor pushed partial ETA. First shipment now slated for 2026-04-03, remaining units TBD. I asked for manifest today.
Maria: Rack power is green, PDUs arriving tomorrow. Need to confirm cable kit counts before we commit to staging slots.
Ben: Cable kits: current inventory 40, requirement 100 across the wave. Ordered +60 (PO# 98765). ETA 2026-04-01.
Jin: CI side: smoke tests are ready to run but we need 8 reserved nodes in staging for a 7-day burn-in. Can infra hold those?
Sam: @infra-bot command we typically use: `/reserve --pool=dedicated-eu --nodes=8 --duration=7d --tags=smoke`
Sam: I can run the request but need approval for the power window from @Maria (so we don't overlap other work).
Maria: Approve for 2026-04-02 12:00-18:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Vendor says they can do a staggered shipment — we'll prioritize the staging nodes in the first crate. I'll confirm serials/manifest once it lands.
Priya: Okay — staggered is fine. Actions: 1) Alex confirm manifest serials when available; 2) Ben update PO tracking link in the buildout doc; 3) @infra-bot create the reservation for those 8 nodes for 4/2. I'll record the window in rollout.md.
infra-bot: Reservation created — ticket INF-4321. Window: 2026-04-02T12:00Z -> 2026-04-09T12:00Z. Nodes: 8 (pool: dedicated-eu).
Jin: I'll schedule the smoke run for 2026-04-02 12:30 UTC and loop in QA. Thanks all. :rocket:
